name: sentinela
description: Sentinela — protótipo de monitoramento de loja autônoma com IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
